name: UIGetDesignSize
summary: Returns the 1920x1080 design resolution used for UI layout.

name: UIGetLayoutScale
summary: Computes design-to-viewport scale, preferring the play-mode game viewport when playing.

name: GetScreenPosition
summary: Converts an element's anchor-relative design position into scaled viewport coordinates.

name: ScreenDeltaToDesignDelta
summary: Converts a viewport pixel delta into design-space units using the current layout scale.

name: HitTest
summary: Returns whether a viewport-local point falls inside the element's screen rectangle.

name: LoadFromJson
summary: Reads script class and properties from JSON and instantiates the attached script.
